impl LaneDrainForTheStrip {
    fn drain_controls_for_lane(&mut self, control: &mut Consumer<Record>) {
        for _ in match self.lane_selector_for_this_block {
            Lane::Left => &self.left_records,
            Lane::Right => &self.right_records,
        }
        .iter()
        {
            let Ok(record) = control.try_pop() else {
                break;
            };
            self.apply(record);
        }
    }
}
